purpose: Existence outer-contour ownership probe: retain every interior pixel by default and remove only multi-frame holes with positive background depth and color evidence.
expected_effect: Keep invalid-depth or stereo-unresolved pixels inside a stable outer contour assigned to that existence.
Remove only interior regions that repeatedly match the depth and color of visible background outside the contour.
Expose retained-no-depth, candidate-hole, confirmed-hole, memory, rejection, and processing-cost metrics.
risk: This probe does not repair an upstream outer contour that was already split into multiple stable materials.
Textured or depth-varying background can conservatively prevent a real hole from being removed.
The filter preserves ownership only; it does not invent dense per-pixel depth or promote unsupported pixels to measured 3D evidence.
